findings.evidence: Rendered ToolTimelineRow cases cover total 1/returned 1 and total 7/returned 2, plus two char_count values. They do not explicitly cover total 0 or absent totals/counts. The shared renderer stringifies numeric zero, while absent info renders blank; removed fallback avoids presenting a fabricated 0.
findings.remedy: A zero-result rendered case would firm up the edge contract; absence should remain unclaimed rather than invented.
